# Termux-Train (v1.0.0)
> Lightweight On-Device Tensor & DAG Autograd Deep Learning Framework for Android

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-train
- Installation: `pip install termux-train`
- Architecture: Provides a clean C-based DAG computation graph with SafeTensors zero-copy serialization and LoRA adapter fine-tuning on smartphone CPUs.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_train as tt
x = tt.tensor([1.0, 2.0], requires_grad=True)
y = (x * 2.0).sum()
y.backward()
```
